cohort: The study included 457,102 Medicaid-insured birthing people from Oregon and South Carolina between 2010 and 2020, with 37,035 having a NICU-admitted infant.
finding: Medicaid recipients with NICU-admitted infants had similar rates of routine postpartum care attendance but significantly higher rates of emergency department utilization and readmission compared to those without NICU-admitted infants.
